parameters.description: Optional window handle. The client should provide a window handle if it displays a dialog or message box. Otherwise, set hwnd to NULL.
parameters.name: hwnd

parameters.description: Optional bind context that controls the parsing operation. This parameter is typically set to NULL.
parameters.name: pbc

parameters.description: Null-terminated UNICODE string with the display name. Because each shell folder defines its own parsing syntax, the form this string can take may vary. The desktop folder, for instance, accepts paths such as "c:\My Docs\My File.txt". It also accepts references to items in the namespace that have a globally unique identifier (GUID) associated with them using the "::{GUID}" syntax. For example, to retrieve a fully qualified identifier list for the control panel from the desktop folder, you can use"{CLSID for My Computer}\::{CLSID for the Control Panel}".
parameters.name: pwszDisplayName

parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG value that receives the number of characters of the display name that was parsed. If your application does not need this information, set pchEaten to NULL, and no value will be returned.
parameters.name: pchEaten

parameters.description: Pointer to an ITEMIDLIST pointer that receives the item identifier list for the object. The returned item identifier list specifies the item relative to the parsing folder. If the object associated with pwszDisplayName is within the parsing folder, the returned item identifier list contains only one SHITEMID structure. If the object is in a subfolder of the parsing folder, the returned item identifier list contains multiple SHITEMID structures. If an error occurs, NULL is returned in this address.
parameters.name: ppidl

parameters.description: Optional parameter that can be used to query for file attributes. If not used, it should be set to NULL.
